vetSays.line: 🛡️ Maricela, Abdul, Maya, Ella and Sigrun met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Maricela, Abdul, Maya, Ella, Sigrun are hurt.
🛡️ Carmine, Maricela, Abdul and Ella met them at the door — 4 put down. Maricela, Abdul, Ella are hurt.
🛡️ Carmine, Maricela and Abdul met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Carmine, Maricela, Abdul are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Maricela just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Abdul, Ella and Sam met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Abdul, Ella, Sam are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ella just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Carmine, Abdul, Ella and Sigrun met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Carmine, Ella are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Abdul just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Abdul, Ella, Sigrun and Lena met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Sigrun, Lena are hurt.

regDeaths.name: a raccoon with too many fingers, working at something
a dog-shaped silence at the treeline
the absence of sound, shaped like wings
